reason: Clean-restart successor authorization after V2 implementation PR #569 became unusable before obtaining a causal RED. V2 authorization #568 was validly ordinary-merged at 9d00f3bd79b4aa0101fb64468ef784c5ff2389aa, and the V2 first tests-only implementation commit c981a80f531ae3cb4a921c2c98d6ab20fb2aa96b correctly used that merge as its sole parent and touched exactly the two authorized diagnostic paths. Before the PR could obtain behavior RED evidence, trusted main concurrently advanced via unrelated governance PR #567 to 0f801375de44e8f64203066b6e0d0c93ff46f1e9. Stage run 32455446234 therefore failed in route setup because the pull-request base was not an ancestor of the V2 head; implementation-branch policy and behavior tests never executed. That infrastructure/topology failure is not accepted as causal RED. A descendant trusted-main merge is not a valid repair because Fast Closure V2 requires post-red/diagnostic first-parent commits to be single-parent and evidence-bound. V3 preserves the identical twenty-path implementation scope, identical two-path diagnostic scope, existing Ollama terminal-success P1 root-fix contract, and all prior quality boundaries; only the successor authorization/implementation branch identities change. No V1/V2 poisoned implementation commit becomes a V3 implementation parent.

predecessorEvidence.v1RootFixBehavior: Require terminal status success before pull returns ok; otherwise fail closed with OLLAMA_PULL_INCOMPLETE.
predecessorEvidence.concurrentTrustedMainCause: PR #567 ordinary-merged an unrelated Windows UAT startup P0 governance authorization after #568.
predecessorEvidence.v2StageFailure: wp0-route failed in Resolve exact event diff range at git merge-base --is-ancestor PULL_REQUEST_BASE_SHA PULL_REQUEST_HEAD_SHA; implementation branch policy and behavior tests never executed.
predecessorEvidence.policyRootCause: The Stage pull-request route requires event base to be an ancestor of head. Fast Closure V2 also requires commits after the first tests-only red head to be single-parent and evidence-bound, so merging advanced main as a descendant cannot safely repair a first commit that never obtained causal RED.
